description.p: DistriBumpy is a Flatpak store drawn in the LineXinBar design language: the same colours, glass, motion and marks as the shell it was made for, and driven from a keyboard, a pointer and a controller at once.

It reads the catalogue every remote already keeps on the disk, so a machine that has been updated once can be browsed with the network unplugged. New applications are installed for the current user by default, which needs no password; anything already installed for the whole system is listed, updated and removed as readily.

It opens on a Home page of what Flathub says is worth looking at — what is asked for most, what is rising fastest, and what has just been published or rebuilt — and everything on offer is shown as a card in a grid that narrows with the window.

It shows what an install would really cost before the press, what changed in each release, and what each application may reach outside its sandbox — with a switch for every permission worth switching, written to this user's own override so that nothing needs a password. Repositories can be added, switched off, refreshed and forgotten from the same pages.
It is an ordinary Wayland application and runs on any desktop.
El Centro de software permite explorar, instalar, actualizar y quitar aplicaciones y juegos Flatpak dentro de la interfaz de LineXinBar.
Busque aplicaciones y consulte capturas, descripciones, valoraciones e información de las versiones. Los catálogos guardados en el disco están disponibles también sin conexión.
Gestione repositorios, actualizaciones y permisos de las aplicaciones con el mando, el teclado o el ratón.
La Logithèque permet de parcourir, installer, mettre à jour et supprimer des applications et des jeux Flatpak depuis l'interface de LineXinBar.
Cherchez des applications et consultez captures d'écran, descriptions, notes et informations de version. Les catalogues enregistrés sur le disque restent consultables hors ligne.
Gérez les dépôts, les mises à jour et les permissions des applications à la manette, au clavier ou à la souris.
Centrum oprogramowania umożliwia przeglądanie, instalowanie, aktualizowanie i usuwanie aplikacji oraz gier Flatpak w interfejsie LineXinBar.
Wyszukuj aplikacje, przeglądaj zrzuty ekranu, opisy, oceny i informacje o wydaniach. Katalogi zapisane na dysku są dostępne również bez połączenia z siecią.
Zarządzaj repozytoriami, aktualizacjami i uprawnieniami aplikacji za pomocą kontrolera, klawiatury lub myszy.
Das Software-Center lässt Sie Flatpak-Anwendungen und -Spiele im Erscheinungsbild von LineXinBar durchsehen, installieren, aktualisieren und entfernen.
Suchen Sie nach Anwendungen und sehen Sie Bildschirmfotos, Beschreibungen, Bewertungen und Versionshinweise. Die auf der Festplatte gehaltenen Kataloge sind auch ohne Netzwerk zu lesen.
Verwalten Sie Repositories, Aktualisierungen und die Berechtigungen einer Anwendung mit Controller, Tastatur oder Maus.
A Central de Programas permite percorrer, instalar, atualizar e remover aplicativos e jogos Flatpak com a aparência do LineXinBar.
Pesquise aplicativos e veja capturas de tela, descrições, avaliações e notas de lançamento. Os catálogos guardados no disco são legíveis mesmo sem rede.
Gerencie repositórios, atualizações e as permissões de um aplicativo com controle, teclado ou mouse.
Центр приложений позволяет просматривать, устанавливать, обновлять и удалять приложения и игры Flatpak в оформлении LineXinBar.
Ищите приложения и смотрите снимки экрана, описания, оценки и заметки о выпусках. Каталоги, сохранённые на диске, читаются и без сети.
Управляйте репозиториями, обновлениями и разрешениями приложения с контроллера, клавиатуры или мыши.
软件中心让您以 LineXinBar 的外观浏览、安装、更新和移除 Flatpak 应用程序与游戏。
搜索应用程序，查看截图、描述、评分和发布说明。保存在磁盘上的目录即使没有网络也能阅读。
用手柄、键盘或鼠标管理仓库、更新和应用程序的权限。
Software Hub speaks the language the session speaks, in ten languages.
A page opens out of the card that was pressed and goes back into it, a category opens best rated rather than by name, and the search field can be stepped back from and clicked like any other control.
Open starts the application that is installed, installing goes to a source that is switched on, and a long caption is cut to the room it has.
The background carries the desktop's sparkles, and follows its Particles setting.
This release shares its version with LineXinBar, lxb-toolkit, CEDM, Imagonsole, Videonsole and SongOnSole.
Shown as Software Hub. It was called Store, which names a category rather than a thing.

Updating everything now carries on past an operation that will not go and names it, instead of stopping and calling it a cancellation; the runtimes and extensions an application stands on are listed and updated with it; and nothing claims a password will be asked for where none is.
A finger moves a list, a scroll bar is there for the hand that is not on a controller, and the application page carries its facts beside the name.
This release shares its version with LineXinBar, lxb-toolkit and CEDM.
